title.narrative: Supporting emergency response by providing and expanding medical supplies and logistical support to those affected in Gaza

description.narrative: - WHO is on the ground, with staff in Gaza - Providing life-saving medicines and medical supplies to 40 health facilities in Gaza. A comprehensive vision plan has been integrated throughout the project implementation to obtain life-saving support from KSRelief. Robust monitoring and evaluation will ensure accurate tracking of progress and corrective action when necessary

Addressing the acute shortage of essential medical supplies, trauma supplies, essential medicines and fuel that is affecting vital functions in all primary health care centres and hospitals, as well as the ability of ambulances to respond. Health services and medical equipment are increasingly disrupted, affecting diagnostic and treatment capabilities.
Reducing and limiting deaths and critical cases resulting from the lack of availability of basic health services, in addition to empowering the health system in the Gaza Strip.
